svg.aria-label: Elk social groups, drawn as small herds. Cow groups: cows, calves and yearlings, up to 20 or more, led by older cows. Bull groups live apart from the cows from spring to late summer. In the September rut a herd bull holds a harem of cows while younger bulls wait on the edge. Source BC elk account, 90 percent; the edge bulls line is a Tip.
svg.text: BC elk account (90%); edge bulls: Tip
